summary: The silence broke — hard. After six days of nothing, Kaitlynn returned on 2026-08-28 with 36 messages across the week (her biggest ever, vs 6 last week) and ALTR finally answered. Almost every item that had been rotting on this account for three weeks got touched: Ollie delivered the first real performance report ever written in this chat (2026-08-29), Mica Vecco resurfaced after 20 days of silence and converted her Calendly the same evening (2026-08-31), Stephski restarted invoicing after 17 days (2026-09-01), and Mayson booked the call she first asked for on 2026-08-14 — this time inside 34 seconds of her re-asking on 2026-09-04. That is a genuine turnaround in responsiveness. But the substance got riskier. She raised her first performance complaint ("this week's numbers are quite lower than the previous two weeks!", 2026-08-28), used the word "unacceptable" for the first time on the account about a $300 day, suspected chatters had been swapped out, hit a Google Drive failure that is blocking hundreds of videos (2026-09-02), and closed the window on 2026-09-04 flagging a chat-team policy breach: "chat team is not allowed to send free full nude previews". Worst of all, the catch-up invoice on 2026-09-01 rolled the $90 back on — the same shortfall Derrek personally waived as a "coupon" on 2026-08-21. Billing has now contradicted the owner in writing, and she has not yet noticed.

health.rationale: Up 2 from 70. Last week's state predicted that if the silence continued past 13 days with the stale stack untouched, this account would be in pre-churn and health should break 60. The opposite happened: she re-engaged at record volume and ALTR responded to nearly everything. Four multi-week stale items closed this week — the Mayson call (21 days), the Mica Calendly (20 days), the invoicing blackout (17 days), and the total absence of any performance reporting (28 days). Response times were good: Mayson answered the call request in 34 seconds, Derrek answered the Drive failure in 31 minutes, Ollie answered the numbers question the next morning with data. That is why this is 'up' and not 'flat'. The score is capped at 72, not higher, because the risks that remain are now harder ones than unresponsiveness: (1) the account is measurably underperforming and she said so — a $300 day she called 'definitely unacceptable'; (2) the chat team broke an explicit client content rule on the last day of the window and it is unresolved; (3) billing reversed the owner's $91 goodwill waiver in writing on the very invoice meant to repair the billing relationship; (4) the Aug 19 never-sold drop is now 28 days unacknowledged and the voice-memo offer 28 days unanswered — the two oldest items on the account did not move. A client who is talking, booking calls and giving constructive criticism is healthier than one going quiet, but she is now openly critical for the first time in five weeks.

The 21-day call request finally closed. She re-asked at 08:43 on 2026-09-04 and was on a call 15 minutes later — Mayson replied in 34 seconds.
Mica Vecco re-engaged after 20 days and converted the Calendly the same evening: pushback at 19:21, personalised recovery at 19:23, 'Scheduled for 2pm Wednesday :)' at 19:29 (2026-08-31).
Invoicing restarted after a 17-day blackout and, for the first time on this account, payment terms were put in writing — 'I ask that you please pay within 7 days' (2026-09-01).
Derrek personally answered the Drive failure in 31 minutes and Mayson offered to do the uploads himself — 'send me all the content and I’ll personally put it in drive!!' (2026-09-02).

She answered both of the questions that had been hanging from 2026-08-27, closing the sub-source and domain-adoption unknowns: 'I haven’t done a swap I’ve just been posting fire content' and 'Took the link of my bio temporarily because i was getting a ton of flags on my account but it’s back on there' (2026-08-28).

Her criticism is constructive and generous in tone throughout — 'No rush! I know it’s Friday too so at yalls convenience was just taking some notes for the week :)' (2026-08-28) and 'have a great weekend everyone!!' (2026-08-29). She is still invested in making this work.
